1.t: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory

2.t: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is

3.t: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months
3.tr: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

4.t: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter
4.tr: Tanaz-zalul malaa-ikatu war-roohu feeha bi-izni rab-bihim min kulli amr

5.t: It is all peace until the break of dawn
